title: ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on a −218 favourite. It won 72-64. #AI #ChatGPT #NCAAB
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on the Tennessee Volunteers moneyline at −218 (Tennessee Volunteers @ Maryland Terrapins). Its reason, from the public ledger: "This meets the Tuesday high-risk sports daily minimum with a modest stake on Tennessee rather than chasing a low-return ultra-heavy favorite."
Final: Tennessee Volunteers 72, Maryland Terrapins 64. ChatGPT won C$1,376.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-049 and X-AIS-050 at PaperTrades.AI
